name: Legal Matter & Conflict Intelligence
tagline: Party-graph conflict screening, court-calendar deadline computation and ethical-wall enforcement — malpractice exposure, engineered away.
business_problem: Law firms take matters that conflict with existing clients, and court deadlines slip — both cause malpractice exposure.
engineering_problem: Graph-walk conflict screening over a parties graph with fuzzy name matching, rule-driven court-deadline computation, and role-based ethical walls.
why_industrial: Direct adversity across matters is detected by graph traversal, fuzzy matches surface as POTENTIAL for analyst review, deadlines are computed from jurisdiction rules and missed deadlines are escalated — the anatomy of legal-grade risk control.
demo_narrative: Captured against a running instance: **parties + matter graph → conflict screen (Delta vs Beta → CONFLICT with the adverse-matter finding; Epsilon vs Zeta → CLEAR) → court deadlines computed from jurisdiction rules → ethical wall blocks LITIGATION_TEAM while the attorney retains access.**
mermaid:
```mermaid flowchart LR P["parties graph
(clients / opponents / related)"] --> SC["Conflict Screener
(normalize + fuzzy match + graph walk)"] SC -->|direct adversity| C["CONFLICT"] SC -->|fuzzy match only| PO["POTENTIAL"] SC -->|no matches| CL["CLEAR"] M["matter + jurisdiction + trigger date"] --> DR["Deadline rules
(days offset)"] DR --> DL["matter_deadlines"] DL -->|past due| MS["MISSED + alert"] W["ethical walls"] -->|role blocked| AX["409 on matter access"] ```
